a_log.response: {"__tool_calls__": [{"type": "function", "index": 0, "id": "toolu_0112hZ8EawEQK2rtCnaTN9Qp", "function": {"name": "write_file", "arguments": "{\"path\": \"median_two_sorted.py\", \"content\": \"def find_median_sorted_arrays(nums1, nums2):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Find the median of two sorted arrays in O(log(min(m, n))) time.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        nums1: First sorted array\\n        nums2: Second sorted array\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        The median value as a float\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Ensure nums1 is the smaller array for binary search efficiency\\n    if len(nums1) > len(nums2):\\n        nums1, nums2 = nums2, nums1\\n\\n    m, n = len(nums1), len(nums2)\\n    half_len = (m + n + 1) // 2\\n\\n    low, high = 0, m\\n\\n    while low <= high:\\n        i = (low + high) // 2   # partition index for nums1\\n        j = half_len - i         # partition index for nums2\\n\\n        if i < m and nums2[j - 1] > nums1[i]:\\n            # i is too small, move right\\n            low = i + 1\\n        elif i > 0 and nums1[i - 1] > nums2[j]:\\n            # i is too large, move left\\n            high = i - 1\\n        else:\\n            # Found the correct partition\\n            if i == 0:\\n                max_left = nums2[j - 1]\\n            elif j == 0:\\n                max_left = nums1[i - 1]\\n            else:\\n                max_left = max(nums1[i - 1], nums2[j - 1])\\n\\n            if (m + n) % 2 == 1:\\n                return float(max_left)\\n\\n            if i == m:\\n                min_right = nums2[j]\\n            elif j == n:\\n                min_right = nums1[i]\\n            else:\\n                min_right = min(nums1[i], nums2[j])\\n\\n            return (max_left + min_right) / 2.0\\n\"}"}}]}
